FOOTNOTES

1/ This appropriation is a continuing appropriation and is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$2,854,500 and 22 FTE Positions from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.
